name: Do I need to remove my old backsplash before a new installation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to remove my old backsplash before a new installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, it is recommended to remove your old backsplash before installing a new one. This ensures a flat, clean surface for the new material, leading to a more secure and professional finish. Installing over an existing backsplash can create an uneven surface and may not adhere properly, potentially causing issues down the line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Removing your old backsplash is usually recommended for a secure and professional new installation.
